gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Wallpoet lets the paper show through between its tall-rising letters. It earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Wancho brings hulking, chalk-thick lowercase with a wide gap at the e's terminal.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-yi: Commanding Wallpoet rises tall and lets the paper show through between its letters. But Noto Sans Yi, deep in the midsection with unsealed rounds, keeps a long run of text moving easily.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-numans: Numans runs wide and loose, its s ends hanging far from the spine. Numans is best at carrying text, while Wallpoet is best at announcing, tall and gapped with paper showing through.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-open-sans: Hard-hitting and tall: Wallpoet lets paper peek between its letters, while Open Sans reads smooth, with no clogged curves. Wallpoet makes the statement; Open Sans carries the bulk of the words.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-orienta: Bold Wallpoet climbs high, leaving gaps where the paper shows between its letters. Yet Orienta is the one built to be read, its breathing counters and near-matching cases doing quiet work.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads with curves that never close back on themselves, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals. But Wallpoet is the one built to announce, tall and gapped with paper showing through.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-preahvihear: A high-rising heading over a lofty, open-mouthed body. Wallpoet lets paper show between its letters and rises with real command, while Preahvihear supplies open mouths and a lofty x-height.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-puritan: Puritan keeps its rounded forms open to the side, with oversized e and a counters that feel friendly and clean. Wallpoet brings the command, tall with paper glimpsed between its letters.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada reads with tall, full c, s and z shapes and a clear opening at every curve's end. And its ruler-straight line weight keeps a page of text moving, far from Wallpoet, the commanding display voice.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-radio-canada-big: Wallpoet rises high and lets paper glow between its letters. What stands out is the weight gap, since Radio Canada Big keeps a monoline width on every letter while Wallpoet does not.
